subject: SEM including 1 latent factor to test mediation

messages.author: 5fb51244c608c070
messages.subject: SEM including 1 latent factor to test mediation
parts:
Hi

Can someone help explain me the output I get?

So I described a latent factor with 4 exogenous variables. With Lav.predict I get the factorscores (LV).

I have made a SEM to test for mediation of the factorscores LV, however I do not fully understand the output because:

When I do a simple regression of 
crude <- svyglm(EdecdurSEM ~ scale(leismethSEM), design)

I understand that the output means 'with +1SD you go 4.8ms up (which does make sense btw ;)

Nonetheless the output of the SEM shows really small coeficients. How do I read this?

SEM Model:
modeledec <- ' # direct effect
EdecdurSEM ~ c*leismethSEM 

# mediator
LV ~ a*leismethSEM 

EdecdurSEM ~ b*LV

# indirect effect (a*b)
ab := a*b

# direct
direff := c

# total effect
total := direff + ab

# pct mediated
med := 100*ab / total
'
